summary: This is an April 1st joke RFC that adapts RFC 1149, which describes sending IP datagrams by carrier pigeon, to IPv6. It is humorous, not a real protocol, though it is written in the style of a serious one.

eli5.summary: Someone wrote a joke rule book for sending internet messages by pigeon, and this one updates it for newer addresses. Nobody is expected to do it for real.

questions: is there an rfc for carrier pigeons
